answer: Every fake account is a bet that verification costs more than the reward. Allotted flight attendant certificate with cabin crew association attestation flips the bet — a certificate the association renews after cabin audits — and the saffron lands on the attacker instead. A single honest agent crosses this gate in seconds; a farm crosses it a hundred times, and the juniper of those crossings is a bill no payout covers. The prism is that the same proof cannot serve two names.
